annual.note: Fiscal 2026 ended Jan 31, 2026. Filer is Marvell Technology, Inc. (Delaware, CIK 1835632; the former Bermuda parent Marvell Technology Group Ltd is CIK 1058057). Balance sheet and share count EXCLUDE the Celestial AI (closed 2026-02-02, cash ~$1.3B + ~24.5M shares + earnout) and XConn (closed 2026-02-10, ~$280M cash + ~2.1M shares) acquisitions and the NVIDIA Series A preferred (2026-03-31) because all occurred after the balance-sheet date (10-K Note 16 Subsequent Events); the Celestial earnout is therefore not a Jan-31 claim. No stock options table is disclosed in the 10-K (options null). Technology license obligations (about $244.5M at Jan 31: current $84.1M + non-current $160.4M, Note 15 of 10-Q comparative) are not included in debt. Customer warrant fair values shown are grant-date values; the FY2025 and FY2026 warrants total up to 5.2M shares.

ttm.note: Latest filed 10-Q is Q2 FY2027 (period ended 2026-08-01, filed 2026-08-28). Common shares exclude the 2.0M Series A preferred (as-converted about 21.8M common equivalents per 10-Q; research package says 21.778M), which is carried as preferredEquity $2,000M; do not count both. Options: the 10-Q gives no option or RSU table; Celestial and XConn assumed options (3.1M and 0.5M shares registered, strikes unknown) exist so options is left null rather than estimated. Aug-18-2026 exact capital (Google warrant exhibit): 876,926,613 common; 30,581,074 shares under options, RSUs and PRSUs at target; legacy customer warrants up to 5,225,854 shares; 22,378,470 earnout shares. Technology license obligations of $220.0M (current $96.2M + non-current $123.8M) are not in debt; restructuring $238.4M and tax payables $249.4M likewise excluded. Unconditional purchase commitments $8,518.9M foundry + $666.3M technology services (Note 9). H1 FY2027 includes $433.7M earnout fair-value expense and $131.0M forward gain in Other expense, below operating income.

notes: Fiscal year ends on the Saturday nearest January 31. FY2026 = year ended 2026-01-31. TTM runs to the Q2 FY2027 quarter end 2026-08-01.
Reviewed package (dist/data/incremental-MRVL-2026-10-18-v3) figures for the Aug-1 balance sheet and Aug-18 capital were re-checked against the 10-Q and the Aug-19 8-K exhibit and agree.
Annual and TTM balance sheets are not comparable for capital: Celestial, XConn, NVIDIA preferred and Google warrant all fall between the two dates.
No convertible notes or capped calls exist at either date; debt is senior unsecured notes only.
